sources.assessment: Compact 2.54M-parameter ImageNet backbone (about 9.8 MB before crop fine-tuning); it is not a crop or disease classifier.
Feature-vector backbone suitable for a compact router or specialist after crop-specific training and ONNX export.
Accuracy-oriented comparison candidate; it still needs crop-specific training, ONNX export, and field evaluation.
54,306 controlled leaf images across 14 species and 38 health/disease classes; useful for warm-start training, not field certification.
2,598 less-controlled images across 13 plant species; useful only as auxiliary external-domain evidence.

sources.assessment: Six rice leaf states with variable resolution; a training candidate, not a released lightweight model.
Wheat foundation checkpoints start at 86M parameters and need a disease head; useful as a benchmark, not the lightweight web runtime.

sources.license: Publisher declares MIT; upstream training-dataset terms require separate review
sources.assessment: A pinned 4.34 MB INT8 ONNX checkpoint with five bean, cassava, and maize labels. It is useful for runtime and modular-routing integration, but its noisy test is synthetic and it has no Indian farmer-phone, OOD, calibration, or agronomist release evidence.
Selected runtime boundary: WASM baseline, optional WebGPU, and the same ONNX artifact on server CPU when compatible.
